title: TinySwords
description: Resource pack that makes swords smaller.
body:
<center>
  
![Tiny Swords](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ebe5ffd93f44a41195f49f48081d88840157c4ee.png)
</center>

---

TinySwords is a simple resource pack for Minecraft 1.21.9 and newer that makes swords smaller. It aims to improve visability during pvp while preserving the vanilla feel.

<center>
  
![All the swords](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fbd40d503f16cbbd3b7f73d7409e537112b6be22_0.webp)
</center>
